nodes.label: Closed Ontology
nodes.rationale: A closed ontology is used so that the knowledge graph is deterministic and verifiable — only concepts and relationships explicitly defined in the ontology are allowed, preventing hallucinated or off-schema structure from entering the graph.

nodes.label: Provenance Tracking
nodes.rationale: Every block of ingested text carries a provenance record so that downstream agents can trace every claim back to the original source file and location, enabling the Judge to verify authenticity.

nodes.label: Design Philosophy
nodes.rationale: The design philosophy is a shared constraint enforced by the Judge to ensure all generated decks adhere to visual and structural standards, decoupled from claim-verification so both concerns are checked independently.
